data.name: Little Astronaut
data.detailed_description:
A SMALL ASTRONAUT. AN UNKNOWN WORLD. AN ABANDONED BASE.

After a crash landing on an alien planet, set out toward a mysterious research base in the distance.

Explore a strange ecosystem, reactivate forgotten machinery, and solve environmental puzzles as you get closer to uncovering what happened here.

Little Astronaut is an atmospheric, top-down sci-fi puzzle adventure focused on exploration, logic, and continuous progression.

EXPLORE AN ALIEN WORLD

Travel through rocky valleys, strange alien vegetation, and an abandoned retro-futuristic research base.

SOLVE ENVIRONMENTAL PUZZLES

Activate machinery, restore systems, and use the environment to open new paths and reach new areas.

UNCOVER THE MYSTERY

The deeper you venture into the base, the more clues you will find about what happened to the expedition.

NO COMBAT.

Just you, an alien world, and the path ahead.
